title: Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes

ingredients.item: Olive oil + salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika (to taste)
each paprika, onion powder and Italian seasoning
Buffalo Wild Wings Garlic Parmesan Sauce (enough to coat)

steps: Potatoes. Peel and cube the potatoes, toss with oil and seasonings, and air fry at 400 °F for about 25 minutes, shaking a few times. (Or oven at 400 °F for about 30 minutes.)
Chicken. Halfway through, cook the cubed chicken in a skillet with the butter over medium-high heat, seasoned with salt, pepper, paprika, onion powder and Italian seasoning.
Sauce. When cooked, add the garlic and enough Garlic Parmesan sauce to coat.
Combine. Stir in the crispy potatoes and top with mozzarella.
Melt. Broil a few minutes (or cover on the stove) until the cheese melts. Top with parsley and extra sauce.
